text: The system shall allow a registered patient to log in using their email address and a password containing at least 8 characters including one special character.
The system shall respond to user login authentication requests within 1.5 seconds under a concurrent load of 500 users.
The application should be user-friendly, fast, and easy to navigate for elderly patients.
The system shall process medical records appropriately when errors occur.
Patients must be able to log into their account using their email address and password.
All patient health record data at rest shall be encrypted using AES-256 encryption standard.
The system shall be robust and never crash under any circumstances.
The system shall export patient appointment history to PDF format within 3 seconds of user request.
The application will try to send SMS notifications to doctors when an urgent lab result is uploaded.
The platform shall generate downloadable PDF reports of patient appointment records upon user request.
The system shall automatically lock a user account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within 10 minutes.
The software should handle large file uploads seamlessly.
The patient portal interface shall comply with WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility guidelines.
The system shall look modern, attractive, and state-of-the-art.
The system shall send an automated email confirmation to the patient within 60 seconds of successful appointment booking.
